correctness.rationale: A fresh direct enumeration of all involutions in S_1, S_2 and S_3 under the stated mesh-cell convention reproduces the record exactly. At n=3 the four involutions give A/B distribution {0:2,1:1,2:1} and C/D distribution {0:1,1:2,2:1}; n=1 and n=2 do not separate the patterns. Thus n=3 is a valid minimal counterexample to four-way involution equidistribution for the four stated patterns. The larger n=7..9 tables remain supporting finite evidence, not part of the logical refutation.
